note: MAU2-related CdLS (CdLS7) exhibits phenotypic overlap with other non-NIPBL cohesinopathies, with variable expressivity ranging from mild to classic forms, requiring molecular or episignature confirmation.

evidence.text: Affected individuals with heterozygous MAU2 variants present with a wide spectrum of manifestations ranging from classic CdLS to milder presentations, sharing consistent features such as short stature and microcephaly, while variant-dependent episignatures differentiate molecular consequences.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 lead to a new Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: Affected individuals display a wide range of phenotypes, from classic CdLS to milder presentations, with short stature and microcephaly as consistent features.
